records.jp: あの……
records.en: Um...

records.jp: あの……日菜子ちゃん！
records.en: Um... Hinako-chan!

records.jp: え？
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: あ！　やっぱり！
records.en: Aha! I knew it!

records.jp: 白井日菜子ちゃん、だよね？<CR>学校に来てくれたんだね！
records.en_original: Hinako Shirai, right? You finally made it to school!
records.en_auxiliary: You're Hinako Shirai, right? You finally made it to school!
records.en: You're Shirai Hinako-chan, right?<CR>You really came to school!

records.jp: そうだけど、えっと……
records.en: That's right, uh...

records.jp: 西田早苗だよ。<CR>中学が一緒だった
records.en_original: Sanae Nishida. We went to the same middle school.
records.en_auxiliary: Sanae Nishida. We went to the same middle school.
records.en: I'm Nishida Sanae.<CR>We went to the same middle school.

records.jp: ……ごめんなさい
records.en: ...Sorry.

records.jp: 気にしないで！<CR>中学では同じクラスだったことなかったし
records.en_original: No worries! We never shared any classes or anything.
records.en_auxiliary: No worries! We never shared any classes or anything.
records.en: Don't worry!<CR>We were never in the same class in middle school.

records.jp: え？　じゃあ、なんで私のことを……？
records.en_original: Huh? Then, how do you know me...?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? Then, how do you know me...?
records.en: Huh? Then, how do you know me...?

records.jp: もちろん知ってるよ！　バレエで有名だったもん。<CR>全校集会でも、みんなの前で表彰されてたじゃない！
records.en_original: How could I not? You WERE a famous ballet dancer. The school even held an assembly in your honor, remember?
records.en_auxiliary: How could I not? You were a famous ballet dancer. The school even held an assembly in your honor, remember?
records.en: Of course I know you! You were famous for ballet.<CR>You were even honored in front of everyone at a school assembly!

records.jp: そう……
records.en: Oh...

records.jp: でも、思ったより元気そうで安心した……
records.en_original: Still, looks like you're doing way better than expected...
records.en_auxiliary: Still, looks like you're doing way better than expected...
records.en: But you seem to be doing better than I expected, so I'm relieved...

records.jp: 『思ったより』って……？
records.en: What do you mean, "better than you expected"...?
...Your... leg.

records.jp: 偶然、だったの……。<CR>中学の卒業前に、先生たちが話しているの、聞こえちゃって……
records.en_original: I just kind of overheard the teachers talking about it before graduation...
records.en_auxiliary: I kind of overheard the teachers talking about it before graduation...
records.en: It was by accident...<CR>Before middle school graduation, I happened to overhear the teachers talking...

records.jp: 私、知ってるの。<CR>日菜子ちゃんが、膝の故障でバレエやめたこと
records.en_original: I'm sorry, Hinako. I know that you quit ballet because of a knee injury.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm sorry, Hinako. I know that you quit ballet because of a knee injury.
records.en: I know.<CR>You quit ballet because of a knee injury, Hinako-chan.

records.jp: 推薦で、この学校の特待科に入るのが決まっていたことも。<CR>バレエをやめたから、普通科になったことも、全部……
records.en_original: And that you'd been accepted into the special program here, but your injury put you down into the regular courses...
records.en_auxiliary: And that you'd been accepted into the special class here, but your injury put you down into the regular one...
records.en: I know you'd been accepted into this school's Special Class on a recommendation,<CR>and that after you quit ballet, you were placed in the Regular Class. I know everything...

records.jp: そう……
records.en: I see...

records.jp: もちろん誰にも言ってない！
records.en_original: But I didn't tell a soul!
records.en_auxiliary: But I didn't tell a soul!
records.en: But I didn't tell a soul!

records.jp: それで、来ないから……、まさか学校も辞めちゃったのかなって、<CR>とても気になっていたの
records.en_original: And, honestly, since it'd been so long since I'd seen you, I thought you might've quit school, too. I was worried.
records.en_auxiliary: And, honestly, since it'd been so long since I'd seen you, I thought you might've quit school, too. I was worried.
records.en: And when you didn't come... I wondered if maybe you'd even quit school.<CR>I was really worried about you.

records.jp: だから、来てくれて嬉しいの！<CR>一緒の高校に通えることが嬉しいの！
records.en_original: But that's why I'm so glad to see you! It's so exciting that we get to go to the same high school!
records.en_auxiliary: So that's why I'm so glad to see you! It's so exciting that we get to go to the same high school!
records.en: But that's why I'm so glad to see you! It's so exciting that we get to go to the same high school!

records.jp: ……もう踊れない私でも？
records.en_original: ...Even if I can never dance again?
records.en_auxiliary: ...Even if I can never dance again?
records.en: ...Even if I can never dance again?

records.jp: うん！
records.en: Of course!

records.jp: バレエを続けられない私なんて――、もう死んでるようなもの
records.en_original: Without my ballet, I'm-- as good as dead.
records.en_auxiliary: Without my ballet, I'm as good as dead.
records.en: If I can't keep dancing ballet, I'm as good as dead.

records.jp: そんなことない！　だって、幽霊は学校に来ないよ？
records.en_original: That's not true! I can't think of any ghosts that get to go to school, can you?
records.en_auxiliary: That's not true! I can't think of any ghosts that go to school, can you?
records.en: That's not true! Ghosts don't come to school, do they?

records.jp: 私ね、中学の頃から日菜子ちゃんに憧れてたの！
records.en_original: You know, Hinako, I admired you so much back in middle school.
records.en_auxiliary: You know, Hinako, I admired you so much back in middle school.
records.en: I've admired you since middle school, Hinako-chan!

records.jp: だから日菜子ちゃんと一緒の高校に通えて、<CR>ホントにホントに嬉しいんだっ！
records.en_original: That's why I'm really, really glad that we're going to high school together, too!
records.en_auxiliary: That's why I'm really, really glad that we're going to high school together, too!
records.en: That's why getting to attend the same high school as you, Hinako-chan...<CR>makes me really, really happy!

records.jp: えへへへへへへ。嬉しいな
records.en: Eheheheheheh. This is so great.

records.jp: ふふふふふふふふふふ
records.en: Hehehehehehehehehehehe.
W-What...?!

records.jp: 嘘……。見えてないの……？
records.en_original: No way... Am I the only one who can see this...?
records.en_auxiliary: No way... Am I the only one who can see this...?
records.en: No way... You can't see it...?

records.jp: あの、どうしたの……？
records.en: Hey, are you okay...?

records.jp: あははははははははは
records.en: Ahahahahahahahahaha.

records.jp: （何……？　明らかにおかしくなってる……。<CR>それに……）
records.en: (What the...? Something's clearly wrong... And...)

records.jp: うふふ。あははははははは
records.en: Hehehe. Ahahahahahahaha.

records.jp: （このままじゃ、かなり危ない気がする）
records.en_original: (If she keeps going like this, there could be trouble.)
records.en_auxiliary: (If she keeps going like this, there could be trouble.)
records.en: (At this rate, this could get pretty dangerous.)

records.jp: どうすれば……
records.en: What should I do...?

records.jp: うわっ！？
records.en: Whoa!
